[binaries]
c = 'clang-filtered'
cpp = 'clang++-filtered'
ar = 'llvm-ar'
strip = 'llvm-strip'
windres = 'llvm-windres'
c_ld = 'lld'
cpp_ld = 'lld'

[properties]
needs_exe_wrapper = true

[host_machine]
system = 'windows'
cpu_family = 'x86_64'
cpu = 'x86_64'
endian = 'little'

[built-in options]
c_args = ['--target=x86_64-w64-windows-gnu', '-march=x86-64-v4', '-mtune=znver4', '-O3', '-fno-plt', '-fomit-frame-pointer']
cpp_args = ['--target=x86_64-w64-windows-gnu', '-march=x86-64-v4', '-mtune=znver4', '-O3', '-fno-plt', '-fomit-frame-pointer']
c_link_args = ['--target=x86_64-w64-windows-gnu', '-fuse-ld=lld']
cpp_link_args = ['--target=x86_64-w64-windows-gnu', '-fuse-ld=lld']
